description: This file contains internal utility functions related to gateway diagnostics and app versioning, primarily used for generating diagnostic reports and copying them to clipboard within an Android application for the OpenClaw project.

methods.name: openClawAndroidVersionLabel
methods.description: Returns the app version label; appends '-dev' if in debug mode and version name is not empty.

methods.name: gatewayStatusForDisplay
methods.description: Normalizes gateway status text for display, defaulting to 'Offline' if empty.

methods.name: gatewayStatusHasDiagnostics
methods.description: Determines if the status indicates diagnostics are required, based on whether it's not 'Offline' or 'connecting'.

methods.name: gatewayStatusLooksLikePairing
methods.description: Checks if the status looks like a pairing or approval message.

methods.name: buildGatewayDiagnosticsReport
methods.description: Creates a detailed diagnostics report string including device info, app version, gateway address, and status.

methods.name: copyGatewayDiagnosticsReport
methods.description: Copies the diagnostics report to the clipboard and shows a toast notification.
